claudeCode.plugin.title: Claude Code
claudeCode.plugin.summary: Lets project and task maintainers run their sessions in Claude Code on this computer, with your own Claude Code setup (CLAUDE.md, skills, MCP, hooks) and the subscription you're signed in with
claudeCode.plugin.sdkMissing: The Claude Code Agent SDK ({package}) isn't installed: it's under Anthropic's own license and doesn't ship with ergo. To use Claude Code, run {command} in ergo's program folder {dir}, then come back here and click Turn on (it uses your own Claude Code login and subscription)
claudeCode.plugin.sdkMissingComponent: The Claude Code Agent SDK ({package}) isn't installed: it's under Anthropic's own license and doesn't ship with ergo. To use Claude Code, install "Claude Code integration" under Settings · Components (downloaded from the official npm registry; or run ergo components add {component} in a terminal), then come back here and click Turn on (it uses your own Claude Code login and subscription)
claudeCode.runtime.title: Claude Code
claudeCode.navigate.ownSummary: Claude Code doesn't write branch summaries itself (Ergo has to write one and pass it in)
claudeCode.navigate.noOps: This Claude Code child process has no session-forking functions, so it can't roll back
claudeCode.navigate.noInput: There's no record of this message being given to Claude Code (sent by an older version, or never given to it), so it can't roll back to before it
claudeCode.navigate.notFound: Can't find where this message is in the Claude Code session (it may be from before its last compaction), so it can't roll back to before it
claudeCode.navigate.cannotRewind: Claude Code says it can't restore the files this time
claudeCode.navigate.noRewind: This Claude Code can't restore files from checkpoints
claudeCode.navigate.offPath: The rollback point isn't on this session's history, so the files weren't restored
claudeCode.tools.ExitPlanMode: Hand in the plan for your approval
claudeCode.sessions.label: Reading local Claude Code sessions
claudeCode.sessions.busyStoppedJob: A stopped background session still holds it ({id}); treated as in use
claudeCode.sessions.busyUnknown: Couldn't check whether it's open somewhere else

claudeCode.remote.checkFailed: Couldn't check whether this session is open right now ({error}), so it was left as it is
claudeCode.remote.stillOpen: {busy}: still open after {seconds} seconds, so it was not handed to the official app (doing so now would start a copy)
claudeCode.remote.copied: Claude Code started a copy ({copy}) instead of continuing the original session; the copy was stopped and nothing was handed over
claudeCode.remote.notStarted: The background session was started but can't be seen running, so it doesn't count as handed over
claudeCode.remote.stopFailed: {busy}: still running {seconds} seconds after stopping, so it was not taken back
